```{r figure_1_map}
# Figure 1: Map of identified SAMHE sites and corresponding DEFRA/AURN sites.

fig1_pairs <- In_Out_24 %>%
  distinct(SchoolId_short, site, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
  select(
    SchoolId_short,
    SAMHE_lon = SchoolLongitude,
    SAMHE_lat = SchoolLatitude,
    AURN_site = site,
    AURN_lon  = longitude,
    AURN_lat  = latitude,
    distance_km = km_distance_to_AURN
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SAMHE_lat), !is.na(AURN_lat), !is.na(distance_km))

fig1_dist_stats <- fig1_pairs %>%
  summarise(
    n_schools = n_distinct(SchoolId_short),
    mean_km   = mean(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_km = median(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_km    = min(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_km    = max(distance_km, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups   = "drop"
  )

fig1_stats_label <- paste0(
  "n = ", fig1_dist_stats$n_schools, "\n",
  "Mean = ", round(fig1_dist_stats$mean_km, 1), " km\n",
  "Median = ", round(fig1_dist_stats$median_km, 1), " km\n",
  "Range = ", round(fig1_dist_stats$min_km, 1), "–", round(fig1_dist_stats$max_km, 0), " km"
)

fig1_samhe_sf <- st_as_sf(fig1_pairs, coords = c("SAMHE_lon", "SAMHE_lat"),
                          crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

fig1_aurn_sf <- st_as_sf(fig1_pairs, coords = c("AURN_lon", "AURN_lat"),
                         crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

fig1_lines_sf <- st_as_sf(
  fig1_pairs %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_sfc(
      st_linestring(matrix(c(SAMHE_lon, SAMHE_lat, AURN_lon, AURN_lat),
                           ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)),
      crs = 4326
    )) %>%
    ungroup(),
  crs = 4326
)

uk <- rnaturalearth::ne_states(country = "United Kingdom", returnclass = "sf")

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = uk, fill = "grey95", colour = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = fig1_lines_sf, colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.25, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = fig1_aurn_sf, shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black",
          size = 1.0, stroke = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = fig1_samhe_sf, colour = "black", shape = 16, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_sf(data = fig1_samhe_sf, aes(color = distance_km), shape = 16, size = 1.3, alpha = 0.5) +
  coord_sf(xlim = c(-8.5, 2.5), ylim = c(49.5, 60.9), clip = "off") +
  scale_color_viridis_c(
    trans = "log10",
    option = "viridis",
    breaks = c(1, 10, 100),
    labels = c("1", "10", "100 km"),
    name = "Distance to nearest AURN"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = c(1.1, 0.8),
    legend.justification = c(1, 0.5),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 95, 5.5, 5.5)
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 57.4, label = fig1_stats_label,
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5) +
  annotate("point", x = 0.65, y = 57.8, shape = 21,
           colour = "black", fill = "white", size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.8, y = 57.8, label = "  AURN sites",
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5)

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_1_SAMHE_AURN_pairing_map.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r daily_time_series}
# Daily mean indoor/outdoor PM2.5 time series.

daily_pm25 <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(DateTime)) %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(
    Indoor_mean   = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    Indoor_q25    = quantile(pm02, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Indoor_q75    = quantile(pm02, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_mean  = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_q25   = quantile(pm2.5, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    Outdoor_q75   = quantile(pm2.5, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -date,
    names_to = c("site", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(Indoor|Outdoor)_(mean|q25|q75)"
  )


daily_r2_spearman <- cor(
  daily_pm25$mean[daily_pm25$site == "Indoor"],
  daily_pm25$mean[daily_pm25$site == "Outdoor"],
  method = "spearman",
  use = "complete.obs"
)^2

ggplot(daily_pm25, aes(x = date, y = mean, colour = site, fill = site)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q25, ymax = q75), alpha = 0.15, colour = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.25) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(Outdoor = "#E57200", Indoor = "#7A1FA2"),
    labels = c(Outdoor = "Outdoor (DEFRA)", Indoor = "Indoor (SAMHE)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Outdoor = "#E57200", Indoor = "#7A1FA2"),
    labels = c(Outdoor = "Outdoor (DEFRA)", Indoor = "Indoor (SAMHE)")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(daily_pm25$date),
    y = max(daily_pm25$mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(daily_r2_spearman, 2), ", p < 0.001"),
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = expression("Daily mean PM"[2.5]),
    colour = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "3 months", date_labels = "%b '%y") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    aspect.ratio = 0.25
  )

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Daily_mean_indoor_outdoor_PM25_timeseries.png"), width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_2_timevariation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Figure 2 supplementary: openair timeVariation of hourly indoor and outdoor PM2.5.

fig2_hourly_all <- In_Out_24 %>%

  fig2_hourly_all,
```

```{r figure_2_scatter_all_time_openair}
# Figure 2: annual mean indoor vs outdoor PM2.5, all-time dataset.

fig2_annual_all <- In_Out_24 %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(indoor_pm25), is.finite(outdoor_pm25))


fig2_r_all <- cor(fig2_annual_all$outdoor_pm25, fig2_annual_all$indoor_pm25)
fig2_p_all <- cor.test(fig2_annual_all$outdoor_pm25,
                       fig2_annual_all$indoor_pm25)$p.value

scatterPlot(
  fig2_annual_all,
  x = "outdoor_pm25",
  y = "indoor_pm25",
  linear = TRUE,
  cor = TRUE,
  xlim = c(0, 20),
  ylim = c(0, 20),
  aspect = 1,
  main = "2023–2025 Indoor vs Outdoor PM2.5 (all time)"
)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_2_annual_indoor_vs_outdoor_PM25_all_time.png"), width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_3_annual_io}
# Figure 3: annual school-year I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5.

fig3_io_annual <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(indoor_pm25), is.finite(outdoor_pm25), outdoor_pm25 > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    io_ratio = indoor_pm25 / outdoor_pm25,
    Year = factor(Year)
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(io_ratio), io_ratio > 0)


fig3_cor <- cor.test(fig3_io_annual$outdoor_pm25,
                     fig3_io_annual$io_ratio,
                     method = "pearson")
fig3_lm <- lm(io_ratio ~ outdoor_pm25, data = fig3_io_annual)

fig3_stats_label <- paste0(
  "n = ", nrow(fig3_io_annual),
  "\nPearson r = ", round(unname(fig3_cor$estimate), 2),
  "\np = ", format.pval(fig3_cor$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 0.001),
  "\nR² = ", round(summary(fig3_lm)$r.squared, 2)
)

ggplot(fig3_io_annual, aes(x = outdoor_pm25, y = io_ratio, colour = Year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = fig3_stats_label,
           hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1.2, size = 5) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Annual mean outdoor PM2.5 (µg m-3)",
    y = "Annual mean I/O ratio",
    colour = "Year",
    title = "Annual mean I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5 (2023–2025)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_3_annual_school_year_IO_ratio_vs_outdoor_PM25.png"), width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_3_seasonal_io}
# Figure 3 seasonal: seasonal I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5.

fig3_io_seasonal <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(DateTime),
    Year = year(date),
    Month = month(date),
    Season = case_when(
      Month %in% c(12, 1, 2)  ~ "Winter",
      Month %in% c(3, 4, 5)   ~ "Spring",
      Month %in% c(6, 7, 8)   ~ "Summer",
      Month %in% c(9, 10, 11) ~ "Autumn"
    ),
    Season = factor(Season, levels = c("Winter", "Spring", "Summer", "Autumn"))
  ) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short, Year, Season) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor   = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor  = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    IO_ratio = indoor / outdoor,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(IO_ratio), is.finite(outdoor), outdoor > 0, IO_ratio > 0) %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(Year))


fig3_season_stats <- fig3_io_seasonal %>%
  group_by(Season) %>%
  summarise(
    r = cor(outdoor, IO_ratio, use = "complete.obs"),
    r2 = summary(lm(IO_ratio ~ outdoor))$r.squared,
    n = n(),
    label = paste0("n = ", n, "\nr = ", round(r, 2), "\nR² = ", round(r2, 2)),
    x = Inf,
    y = Inf,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(fig3_io_seasonal, aes(x = outdoor, y = IO_ratio, colour = Year)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.9) +
  geom_smooth(aes(group = 1), method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Season) +
  geom_text(
    data = fig3_season_stats,
    aes(x = x, y = y, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 1.1,
    vjust = 1.1,
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 20), ylim = c(0, 2)) +
  labs(
    x = "Seasonal mean outdoor PM2.5 (µg m-3)",
    y = "Seasonal mean I/O ratio",
    colour = "Year",
    title = "Seasonal I/O ratio vs outdoor PM2.5 (school hours, 2023–2025)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_3_seasonal_IO_ratio_vs_outdoor_PM25.png"), width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_4_ventilation_type}
# Figure 4: Indoor PM2.5 vs ventilation type.

fig4_ventilation <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, BuildingEnvironment) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BuildingEnvironment), is.finite(indoor_pm25))

fig4_anova <- aov(indoor_pm25 ~ BuildingEnvironment, data = fig4_ventilation)
fig4_anova_tab <- summary(fig4_anova)[[1]]
fig4_f <- round(fig4_anova_tab$`F value`[1], 2)
fig4_p <- signif(fig4_anova_tab$`Pr(>F)`[1], 2)

fig4_n <- fig4_ventilation %>%
  count(BuildingEnvironment)

fig4_ymax <- max(fig4_ventilation$indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(fig4_ventilation, aes(x = BuildingEnvironment, y = indoor_pm25)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_text(
    data = fig4_n,
    aes(x = BuildingEnvironment, y = fig4_ymax * 1.03, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig4_ymax * 1.12,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0("ANOVA: F = ", fig4_f, ", p = ", fig4_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Ventilation type",
    y = expression("Annual mean indoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg/m"^3*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

summary(fig4_anova)

ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_4_indoor_PM25_by_ventilation_type.png"), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_4_ventilation_group}
# Figure 4 alternative: grouped ventilation comparison.

fig4_vent_group <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, BuildingEnvironment) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(BuildingEnvironment), is.finite(indoor_pm25)) %>%
  mutate(
    Vent_group = case_when(
      BuildingEnvironment %in% c("Heating and Mechanical Ventilation", "Air Conditioning") ~ "Mechanical",
      BuildingEnvironment == "Heating and Natural Ventilation" ~ "Natural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Vent_group))

fig4_vent_ttest <- t.test(indoor_pm25 ~ Vent_group, data = fig4_vent_group)
fig4_vent_p <- signif(fig4_vent_ttest$p.value, 2)

fig4_vent_n <- fig4_vent_group %>%
  count(Vent_group)

fig4_vent_ymax <- max(fig4_vent_group$indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(fig4_vent_group, aes(x = Vent_group, y = indoor_pm25)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_text(
    data = fig4_vent_n,
    aes(x = Vent_group, y = fig4_vent_ymax * 1.03, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig4_vent_ymax * 1.12,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0(
      "t-test p = ", fig4_vent_p, "\n",
      "Mechanical = Heating & Mechanical Ventilation + Air Conditioning\n",
      "Natural = Heating & Natural Ventilation"
    ),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Ventilation group",
    y = expression("Annual mean indoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg/m"^3*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_4_indoor_PM25_by_ventilation_group.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

fig4_vent_ttest
```

```{r figure_5_imd}
# Figure 5: Indoor PM2.5 vs IMD decile.

fig5_imd <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25 = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, IMD_decile) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(IMD_decile), is.finite(indoor_pm25)) %>%
  mutate(IMD_decile = factor(IMD_decile, levels = 1:10))

fig5_spearman <- cor.test(
  fig5_imd$indoor_pm25,
  as.numeric(as.character(fig5_imd$IMD_decile)),
  method = "spearman"
)

fig5_rho <- round(unname(fig5_spearman$estimate), 2)
fig5_p <- signif(fig5_spearman$p.value, 2)

fig5_n <- fig5_imd %>%
  count(IMD_decile)

fig5_ymax <- max(fig5_imd$indoor_pm25, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(fig5_imd, aes(x = IMD_decile, y = indoor_pm25)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, fill = "grey85") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", shape = 23, size = 2.5, fill = "black") +
  geom_text(
    data = fig5_n,
    aes(x = IMD_decile, y = fig5_ymax * 1.05, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig5_ymax * 1.15,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", fig5_rho, "\np = ", fig5_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "IMD decile (1 = most deprived, 10 = least deprived)",
    y = expression("Annual mean indoor PM"[2.5]~"(µg/m"^3*")")
  ) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_5_indoor_PM25_by_IMD_decile.png"), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_8_co2_io}
# Figure 8: CO2 vs I/O PM2.5 ratio.

fig8_co2_io <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  mutate(Year = as.integer(format(DateTime, "%Y"))) %>%
  filter(Year %in% 2023:2025) %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    co2          = mean(rco2, na.rm = TRUE),
    io_ratio     = indoor_pm25 / outdoor_pm25,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(io_ratio), is.finite(co2), outdoor_pm25 > 1, io_ratio < 5)

fig8_stats <- fig8_co2_io %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    rho = round(cor(co2, io_ratio, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 2),
    p = signif(cor.test(co2, io_ratio, method = "spearman")$p.value, 2),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

fig8_ymax <- max(fig8_co2_io$io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(fig8_co2_io, aes(x = co2, y = io_ratio, colour = factor(Year))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = min(fig8_co2_io$co2, na.rm = TRUE),
    y = fig8_ymax,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0(
      paste0("Year ", fig8_stats$Year,
             ": n=", fig8_stats$n,
             ", ρ=", fig8_stats$rho,
             ", p=", fig8_stats$p),
      collapse = "\n"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean CO2 (ppm)",
    y = "Indoor / Outdoor PM2.5 ratio",
    colour = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_8_CO2_vs_IO_ratio.png"), width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r figure_9_hepa}
# Figure 9: Annual mean I/O PM2.5 ratio by HEPA status.

fig9_hepa <- In_Out_SchHrs %>%
  group_by(SchoolId_short) %>%
  summarise(
    indoor_pm25  = mean(pm02, na.rm = TRUE),
    outdoor_pm25 = mean(pm2.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    io_ratio     = indoor_pm25 / outdoor_pm25,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    df_school_chars %>%
      select(SchoolId_short, MonitoringType) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = "SchoolId_short"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(MonitoringType), is.finite(io_ratio)) %>%
  mutate(
    HEPA = case_when(
      MonitoringType == 1 ~ "No HEPA",
      MonitoringType == 2 ~ "HEPA",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(HEPA))

fig9_ttest <- t.test(io_ratio ~ HEPA, data = fig9_hepa)
fig9_p <- signif(fig9_ttest$p.value, 2)

fig9_n <- fig9_hepa %>%
  count(HEPA)

fig9_ymax <- max(fig9_hepa$io_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(fig9_hepa, aes(x = HEPA, y = io_ratio)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_text(
    data = fig9_n,
    aes(x = HEPA, y = fig9_ymax * 1.03, label = paste0("n=", n)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 3
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1,
    y = fig9_ymax * 1.12,
    hjust = 0,
    label = paste0("t-test p = ", fig9_p),
    size = 4
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Annual mean indoor / outdoor PM2.5 ratio"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "Figure_9_IO_ratio_by_HEPA_status.png"), width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)

fig9_ttest
```
